{{Top|leg}}
An '''electro-lite pointer''' was a device used by individuals to highlight details during briefings that utilized [[Hologram/Legends|holograms]]. [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] used an electro-lite pointer while briefing [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] for the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].
